title: Zesty Crispy Mexican Tomato Tacos
description: Earthy, crispy tacos featuring tomato juice, fried tamales, and a salt block, perfect for a keto-friendly solo dinner.
instructions: In a bowl, combine almond flour, egg, xanthan gum, and 1 tsp of salt to form a dough, then roll into small tamale shapes.
Place a salt block in the oven and preheat to 450°F.
Heat olive oil and butter in a skillet over medium‑high heat, add diced tomatoes and spices, and cook until tomatoes soften, about five minutes.
Add tomato juice to the skillet, bring to a simmer, and let reduce for three minutes.
Fold shredded mozzarella into the tomato mixture, stirring until melted.
Remove the skillet from heat, allow the mixture to cool slightly, then stir in chopped cilantro.
Place each tamale onto the hot salt block, positioning them flat.
Cook tamales on the salt block for four minutes on each side, until edges are crispy and golden.
Use a spatula to transfer cooked tamales to a serving plate.
Serve tacos hot, optionally garnishing with extra cilantro or lime wedges.
